families.description: Lustify SDXL is a community fine-tune of Stable Diffusion XL, built for uncensored, adult-oriented photorealistic images. It accepts prompts of up to 1,500 characters.

families.name: Whisper Large V3
families.description: Whisper Large V3 is OpenAI's open-weight speech recognition model, trained on about 5 million hours of audio and able to transcribe around 100 languages. It's a robust general-purpose choice for multilingual transcription.

families.name: Anime
families.description: Anime (WAI) is WAI-Illustrious, a community anime checkpoint built on Illustrious XL, for anime illustration, including uncensored adult content. It accepts prompts of up to 1,500 characters.

families.name: Lustify v7
families.description: Lustify v7 is version 7 of the Lustify community SDXL checkpoint, built for uncensored, adult-oriented photorealistic images. It accepts prompts of up to 1,500 characters.

families.name: Qwen Image
families.description: Qwen Image is Alibaba's open-weight text-to-image model, known for close prompt adherence and accurate text rendering, including Chinese. It accepts prompts of up to 2,048 characters.

families.name: Kling 2.6 Pro
families.description: Kling 2.6 Pro is Kling AI's full-quality video model with native audio generation. This text-to-video variant generates 5- or 10-second clips, with optional audio.

families.name: Veo 3.1 Fast
families.description: Veo 3.1 Fast is a faster version of Google's Veo 3.1 video model. This text-to-video variant generates 4-, 6- or 8-second clips at up to 4K, with optional audio.

families.name: Veo 3.1 Full Quality
families.description: Veo 3.1 Full Quality runs Google's Veo 3.1 video model at full quality. This text-to-video variant generates 4-, 6- or 8-second clips at up to 4K, with optional audio.

families.name: Llama 3.2 3B
families.description: Llama 3.2 3B is a lightweight model from Meta's Llama 3.2 family, sized for fast, low-cost tasks such as summarization, classification and rewriting.

families.name: GLM 4.6
families.description: GLM-4.6 is a large language model developed by Z.ai, featuring strong reasoning capabilities and support for multiple languages. Supports a large context window for processing extensive text and detailed analysis.
